name: CONUS
full_name: COherent Neutrino nUcleus Scattering experiment at Brokdorf
summary: CONUS used low-threshold germanium detectors at the Brokdorf power reactor in Germany to search for coherent elastic reactor-antineutrino scattering. Its completed Brokdorf campaign provided the technical and background-control foundation for CONUS+ in Switzerland.
physics_targets: Neutrino interactions beyond the Standard Model
detection_principle: Point-contact high-purity germanium spectrometers measure small ionization pulses. Passive shielding and a cosmic-ray veto reduce backgrounds; reactor-on/off exposures and detailed background modelling constrain nuclear-recoil signals and neutrino electromagnetic interactions.

status.label: Completed / historical

results.summary: The final Brokdorf result constrained the CEvNS rate to within a factor 1.6 of the Standard Model expectation; it was a limit rather than a positive signal.

science_scope: Brokdorf phase only. The Leibstadt observation is recorded separately as CONUS+.
